text: Superseding PAWL-027 AC3 dropped the general obligation it carried and kept only AC5's path list, which is AC4's proxy for it. internal/cli/cli.go turns decision.Allowed into the gate's process result and can change which changesets pass without touching a listed module, so those paths would have bypassed disclosure while the spec read as though nothing was lost. AC13 restores the obligation at checkable: no
